name: Chicken with a Chinese Accent
description: A sweet and savory chicken dish with a Chinese-inspired flavor profile, featuring soya sauce and brown sugar.

recipeInstructions.text: Fry chicken breasts in a frying pan with oil and soya sauce until the outsides are done.
Transfer the chicken to a casserole dish.
Mix the remaining ingredients with soya sauce and pour over the chicken.
Bake for 35 minutes at 350°F.
Serve the chicken with rice.

keywords: Chinese chicken, sweet and savory, baked chicken

_similar.name: Classy Chicken
_similar.description: A creamy, curry-flavored chicken dish with asparagus or broccoli and a cheddar cheese topping.
recipeIngredient: 1 (10 oz) pkg frozen asparagus or broccoli

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the chicken into 2×4 inch pieces and sprinkle with pepper.
Saute the chicken slowly in oil over medium heat until white and clear, about 6 minutes. Drain.
Cook asparagus or broccoli until tender crisp, drain, and arrange in the bottom of a buttered 7-inch diameter casserole dish.
Place the cooked chicken on top of the asparagus or broccoli layer.
Mix the cream of chicken soup, mayonnaise, curry powder, and lemon juice together and pour over the chicken.
Sprinkle the grated cheddar cheese over the top.
Bake, uncovered, at 375 °F for 30 to 35 minutes.

_similar.keywords: creamy chicken, curry chicken, asparagus, cheddar cheese

_similar.name: Thai Chicken
_similar.description: A Thai-inspired chicken dish with spaghetti, vegetables, and a tangy sauce, served hot or chilled.
recipeIngredient: 2 tsp Sambal Oelek or hot pepper sauce

recipeInstructions.text: Cook pasta according to package directions for the minimum time. Drain, rinse with cold water, and drain again.
Stir pasta in a large bowl to coat with sesame oil.
Finely grate the peel from 1 lime and squeeze juice to measure 1/4 cup. Stir juice, peel, soya sauce, hot pepper sauce, salt, and sugar into pasta.
Slice chicken into bite-size pieces, thinly slice pepper, onion, and celery, and julienne carrots.
Stir-fry chicken in batches and return to the pan with garlic and onions. Stir-fry about 3 minutes.
Stir in water, peppers, celery, and carrots. Continue stirring about 3 minutes, adding a bit more water if necessary.
Add snow peas and stir about 1 minute.
Toss with the pasta, serve right away, or chill overnight and serve cold the next day.

_similar.name: Chicken Supreme
_similar.description: A hearty chicken dish with tomatoes, herbs, and cheese, baked to perfection and served over rice or pasta.

recipeInstructions.text: Boil the chicken breasts in a separate container until pink is gone (about 1/4 of the way cooked).
In a baking or roasting pan, mix together the tomato ingredients (stewed tomatoes, green pepper, onion, basil, oregano, garlic).
Place the partially cooked chicken breasts in the bottom of the pan.
Sprinkle spices over the chicken breasts.
Pour the remaining tomato mixture on top of the chicken breasts.
Cover and bake at 350°F for approximately ½ hour.
Sprinkle grated cheese on top, cover, and bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Serve over rice or pasta.

_similar.keywords: chicken supreme, baked chicken, Italian-style chicken

_similar.name: Chinese Hamburger Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty, savory casserole featuring ground hamburger, rice, and vegetables, with an optional addition of bean sprouts for an authentic touch.

recipeInstructions.text: Thoroughly brown hamburger in a skillet; add the onions, celery, cream of mushroom and cream of chicken soups.
Stir in the mushrooms, warm water, uncooked rice, soya sauce, pepper and salt.
Add bean sprouts if using for a more authentic taste.
Turn the ingredients into a casserole dish and bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.
Remove cover, stir the casserole and continue baking for about 15 minutes longer.
Sprinkle chow mein noodles over casserole and bake for 15 minutes more (total baking time is 1 hour).

_similar.keywords: Chinese casserole, hamburger casserole, rice casserole

_similar.name: Favourite Chicken
_similar.description: A simple and satisfying chicken dish baked with cheddar cheese, mushroom soup, and garlic.
recipeIngredient: 1 can cheddar cheese soup (or other soup to taste)

recipeInstructions.text: Wash and pat dry chicken breasts.
Combine cheddar cheese soup, mushroom soup, and garlic powder. Mix well.
Place chicken in a 9x11 inch baking dish. Pour soup mixture over chicken.
Top with grated cheese and sliced mushrooms.
Bake at 350°F for about 1 hour for 4 pieces or 1½ hours for 6 pieces.
Check to ensure chicken is cooked through, as oven temperatures may vary.

_similar.keywords: baked chicken, cheddar cheese, mushroom soup, comfort food
